description: Pre-registered keyless challenge set for raw vs thorn-proof/1 vs thorn-proof/1 plus one bounded exact source rescue. Do not tune cases, prompts, protocol, or proof-language rendering in response to live outcomes.

intended_scoring.rule: A finding counts as correct only when its explanation identifies the planted mathematical issue; taxonomy-category agreement alone is insufficient.

cases.expected_issue: clean control: cancellation is explicitly restricted to a nonzero factor
cancellation divides by a without assuming a != 0; a=0 is a counterexample
clean control: the downstream result uses a valid upstream lemma
the downstream theorem relies on a flawed lemma whose square-root step loses sign
clean control: expository prose is not consumed as mathematical support
an unsupported full-rank assertion in prose is consumed by a downstream mathematical step
clean control: unusual notation is consistently scoped and unambiguous
the same notation is reused for incompatible roles, making the mathematical reference ambiguous
clean control: the quotient-map definition is independent of representative
the proposed quotient-map value depends on the representative, so the definition is not well-defined
a forall-exists witness is illegitimately reused as one exists-forall witness
the proof establishes boundedness only, not attainment of extrema as the theorem claims
a supporting lemma silently assumes every nontrivial zeta zero has real part 1/2, i.e. RH
